author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two straight swords crossed square at the centre, points at the top corners, each with a crossguard near its grip as in the reference; mirrored about x=24. The rejected drawing drew double-edged blades whose crossing made small diamond holes and heavy guards.
omissions: Blades are single strokes rather than double-edged capsule outlines (two outlines crossing would leave pockets under 8 units at 48px).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'swords': diagonal blades with short square guards.
